label: The causal MEANS_1 principle governs trolley permissibility
paraphrase: Analyst formulation, attribution deferred. For each trolley scenario, intervening is permissible exactly when the one's harm is not a causal means (MEANS_1) to the saving and strictly fewer die. One Kantian-inspired reading, without maxims or consent.
